_README: Per-project adapter. Everything project-specific lives here; the scripts in src/ are generic. A second project is a second file in this directory, never a second script. Set `vault` and `repo` to absolute paths on your machine, or export ORCH_VAULT / ORCH_REPO.

test._note: Authoritative since bbc5b29 (2026-08-09) created it in the app repo. It travels with branches and worktrees, which the vault copy cannot. Keyed by branch name; the value is an object with a `count` field, or a bare number in older entries.

design._note: Sum of the numeric top-level values, ignoring keys that start with underscore. The file's own _comment states this rule. Measured 653 on origin/main at fa8ab3d.

functions._note: W2's lane. functions/test-floor.json is NESTED — {unit:{count},rules:{count}} — because npm test and test:rules gate different files and move independently. Field is a DOTTED PATH. Added 2026-08-12 (D83) after a W2 packet quoted the Flutter floor 3062 to a window whose suite measures 342. W0's first fix used field 'count' after misreading a probe that had printed the 'unit' sub-object as if it were the top level.

W0.gate: none — never runs a gate, never edits lib/

W1.note: The only window in lib/. One flutter test suite at a time is the project's real throughput ceiling.

W3.gate: 5-gate bake loop, terminating in a blind /critic
W3.note: Split from the furniture lane 2026-08-25 so characters and furniture skins can run in parallel. W5 owns furniture. The two path sets are DISJOINT by construction — if a brief needs both, it is two briefs.

W4.note: Lost vault ownership on 2026-08-11 to W0's single-writer rule. panes/README.md updated in the same change.

W5.gate: 5-gate bake loop, terminating in a blind /critic
W5.note: Second art window, added 2026-08-25 to finish the finish ladders. 17 of 40 props carry one; 23 do not. The pattern is proven — one bake_<prop>_variants.py per family. SHARED GATE WARNING: W5 and W3 both run Blender and may both want `make test` to show the floor unmoved. Only ONE Dart suite at a time across ALL windows — pgrep -fl flutter_tester and BRANCH on the result; a check you do not branch on is a log line. Contention is attributable: the tester command line carries --packages=.../.worktrees/<NAME>/.

budgets._note: PROPOSED, NOT MEASURED. A model cannot meter its own token spend, so these are enforced on two sides: W0 sizes the brief to its class at dispatch, and the window stops when its context indicator crosses the checkpoint. A discipline with an observable trigger, not a meter.

feature.onCheckpoint: return or handoff — never push through degraded
